obligations.requirement: The exact perfect-freehand commit and required source blobs are content-bound before fixture generation.
acceptance: all required blob SHAs match reference.lock.json

obligations.requirement: MIT attribution accompanies copied/adapted reference material.
acceptance: MIT text and copyright notice are retained in verification/reference/perfect_freehand

obligations.requirement: The input/options corpus is deterministic and matches corpus-plan.json.
acceptance: normal and REFERENCE_KNOWN_LIMITATION classes are preserved
long_wave_512 is materialized to concrete input points

obligations.requirement: Expected StrokePoint and outline fixtures are produced by the pinned upstream implementation, not by the C++ port.
acceptance: every fixture binds upstream commit, input ID, source manifest and generator provenance
generation happens before production C++ kernel mutation

obligations.requirement: Known upstream failure modes are separated from normal parity fixtures without changing pinned behavior.
acceptance: no silent behavioral fix under the reference version

obligations.requirement: C++ conditioned StrokePoint output matches the pinned source.
C++ ordered outline output matches the pinned source.
Real and simulated pressure behavior matches the pinned source.
One-point and two-point special handling matches the pinned source.
Taper and cap semantics match the pinned source.
acceptance: end-noise behavior covered by fixture or focused test

obligations.requirement: Normal sharp-corner behavior matches the pinned source.
Known-limit fixtures reproduce the pinned source and remain labeled.
The one-shot C++ evaluator is deterministic on repeated execution.
acceptance: same build/toolchain produces identical counts and scalar bit patterns or documented deterministic normalized digest

obligations.requirement: R0+R1 does not mutate renderer/platform/Arc/canonical semantics and preserves relevant ink regressions.
acceptance: existing G45ProgrammableBrush and relevant runtime/ink tests pass

sequence: Complete R0 reference fixture materialization first.
Add R1 acceptance tests against the intended C++ kernel API without implementing the production kernel.
Run the tests against the pre-change production code.
oracle_precondition.expected_failure: R1 kernel API/implementation is absent, so parity tests must not pass.
oracle_precondition.observation_seam: runtime/ink pure vector reference kernel tests
